results.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Customer
SELECT count(*) FROM Track T JOIN Genre G ON T.GenreId = G.GenreId WHERE G.Name = 'Rock'
SELECT ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) FROM Invoice
SELECT BillingCountry, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS TotalRevenue FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT T2.Name, COUNT(T1.AlbumId) AS AlbumCount FROM Album AS T1 JOIN Artist AS T2 ON T1.ArtistId = T2.ArtistId GROUP BY T2.Name ORDER BY AlbumCount DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT g.Name, ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 2) AS TotalRevenue FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId GROUP BY g.Name ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT date_part('year', InvoiceDate) AS Year, COUNT(InvoiceId) AS InvoiceCount FROM Invoice GROUP BY Year ORDER BY Year
SELECT BillingCountry, ROUND(AVG(Total), 2) AS AverageTotal FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry HAVING COUNT(InvoiceId) >= 5

WITH CustomerSpending AS (
    SELECT 
        c.Country, 
        c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName AS FullName, 
        ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) AS TotalSpent
    FROM Customer c
    JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
    GROUP BY c.Country, FullName
),
RankedSpending AS (
    SELECT 
        Country, 
        FullName, 
        TotalSpent,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY Country ORDER BY TotalSpent DESC) as rnk
    FROM CustomerSpending
)
SELECT Country, FullName, TotalSpent
FROM RankedSpending
WHERE rnk = 1
SELECT Name FROM Artist WHERE ArtistId NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT Album.ArtistId FROM Album JOIN Track ON Album.AlbumId = Track.AlbumId JOIN InvoiceLine ON Track.TrackId = InvoiceLine.TrackId)
SELECT count(*) FROM Invoice WHERE date_part('year', InvoiceDate) = 2012
SELECT ROUND(AVG(Milliseconds) / 60000, 2) FROM Track
SELECT Country, COUNT(CustomerId) FROM Customer GROUP BY Country
SELECT month(InvoiceDate) AS Month, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS Revenue FROM Invoice WHERE year(InvoiceDate) = 2012 GROUP BY Month ORDER BY Month
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN BillingCountry = 'USA' THEN Total ELSE 0 END) / SUM(Total), 2) FROM Invoice
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track WHERE TrackId NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT TrackId FROM InvoiceLine)

SELECT FirstName || ' ' || LastName AS FullName, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS TotalSpent FROM Customer JOIN Invoice ON Customer.CustomerId = Invoice.CustomerId GROUP BY FullName HAVING TotalSpent > (SELECT AVG(CustomerTotal) FROM (SELECT SUM(Total) AS CustomerTotal FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId)) ORDER BY TotalSpent DESC
SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT CustomerId FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId HAVING count(InvoiceId) > 6) AS sub
SELECT G.Name, ROUND(AVG(T.Milliseconds) / 60000, 2) AS AverageLengthMinutes FROM Genre G JOIN Track T ON G.GenreId = T.GenreId GROUP BY G.Name ORDER BY AverageLengthMinutes DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT FirstName || ' ' || LastName AS FullName, COUNT(DISTINCT T.GenreId) AS GenreCount FROM Customer C JOIN Invoice I ON C.CustomerId = I.CustomerId JOIN InvoiceLine IL ON I.InvoiceId = IL.InvoiceId JOIN Track T ON IL.TrackId = T.TrackId GROUP BY FullName HAVING GenreCount > 5

WITH MonthlyRevenue AS (
    SELECT 
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM InvoiceDate) AS Month,
        ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS Revenue
    FROM Invoice
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM InvoiceDate) = 2011
    GROUP BY 1
),
RevenueWithLag AS (
    SELECT 
        Month,
        Revenue,
        LAG(Revenue) OVER (ORDER BY Month) AS PrevRevenue
    FROM MonthlyRevenue
)
SELECT 
    Month,
    Revenue,
    ROUND(Revenue - PrevRevenue, 2) AS Change
FROM RevenueWithLag
WHERE Month BETWEEN 2 AND 12
ORDER BY Month

SELECT T3.Name, COUNT(DISTINCT T1.GenreId) AS GenreCount FROM Track AS T1 JOIN Album AS T2 ON T1.AlbumId = T2.AlbumId JOIN Artist AS T3 ON T2.ArtistId = T3.ArtistId GROUP BY T3.Name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T1.GenreId) >= 3

SELECT g.Name, ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) * 100.0 / (SELECT SUM(UnitPrice * Quantity) FROM InvoiceLine), 2) AS Percentage FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId GROUP BY g.Name

SELECT FirstName || ' ' || LastName FROM Customer WHERE CustomerId NOT IN (SELECT T1.CustomerId FROM Invoice AS T1 JOIN InvoiceLine AS T2 ON T1.InvoiceId = T2.InvoiceId JOIN Track AS T3 ON T2.TrackId = T3.TrackId JOIN Genre AS T4 ON T3.GenreId = T4.GenreId WHERE T4.Name = 'Latin')

SELECT FirstName || ' ' || LastName AS FullName, InvoiceDate, Total FROM Customer JOIN (SELECT CustomerId, InvoiceDate, Total, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerId ORDER BY InvoiceDate DESC) as rnk FROM Invoice) AS LatestInvoices ON Customer.CustomerId = LatestInvoices.CustomerId WHERE rnk = 1
